title: Context Fabric Result Feedback Request v1
description: Sets the caller's feedback on one of its own Ask Dev results: POST /api/v1/context-fabric/investigations/feedback/{result_id}. The body is the whole feedback, so a repeat is harmless. Both flags are required; unset clears one. No field is nullable.

correct.description: Whether the caller found the answer correct: yes, no, or unset.

useful.description: Whether the caller found the answer useful: yes, no, or unset.
